title: Observability: FIPS gate failure in DO_KDF, KEY_IMPORT, KEY_GENERATE emits no log
description: ioctl_do_kdf (fd.c:1773), ioctl_key_import (fd.c:1636), and ioctl_key_generate (fd.c:1914) call ops->fips_gate() and silently fall through to the error exit if it returns non-zero — no pr_err or pr_debug is emitted in fd.c at these sites. The gate itself emits a rate-limited message but without algo name or operation context. A support engineer cannot determine whether the FIPS rejection was for a KDF, key import, or key generation without a debugger, and cannot correlate the message to the specific algorithm or provider involved. Contrast: ioctl_init does log the FIPS gate rejection with provider name at fd.c:734.
